queries.sql: SELECT n.notification_personne_id AS id, n.sujet, n.envoye_le, n.lu_le, n.canal_notification_id, n.statut_notification_id, n.plainte_id, n.personne_id, c.description_canal_notification AS channel, s.description_statut_notification AS status_label, TRIM(CONCAT(COALESCE(p.prenom_personne, ''), ' ', COALESCE(p.nom_personne, ''))) AS recipient_name, pl.numero_dossier AS case_number, p.province_naissance_id, p.commune_naissance_id FROM "notification"."notification_personne" "n" LEFT JOIN "notification"."canal_notification" "c" ON "c"."canal_notification_id" = "n"."canal_notification_id" LEFT JOIN "notification"."statut_notification" "s" ON "s"."statut_notification_id" = "n"."statut_notification_id" LEFT JOIN "plaignant"."personne" "p" ON "p"."personne_id" = "n"."personne_id" LEFT JOIN "plainte"."plainte" "pl" ON "pl"."plainte_id" = "n"."plainte_id" ORDER BY "n"."envoye_le" DESC, "n"."notification_personne_id" DESC

SELECT DISTINCT p.personne_id AS id, TRIM(CONCAT(COALESCE(p.prenom_personne, ''), ' ', COALESCE(p.nom_personne, ''))) AS label FROM notification.notification_personne n JOIN plaignant.personne p ON p.personne_id = n.personne_id ORDER BY label

SELECT DISTINCT pl.plainte_id AS id, COALESCE(pl.numero_dossier, CONCAT('ID ', pl.plainte_id::text)) AS label FROM notification.notification_personne n JOIN plainte.plainte pl ON pl.plainte_id = n.plainte_id ORDER BY label
